entries:
If you want to enjoy the slow life, visit
White Forest.

If you want to enjoy vibrant city life,
visit Black City.

People who yearn for nature often move
into White Forest.

People who yearn for hustle and bustle
often move into Black City.

As the residents change, the city
also changes.{VAR BE01}
When I look at the changes for a while,
the city looks like a gigantic creature.
